content.text: {"headline":"Approve P4: chat deflection, callbacks and lighter overtime on General lifts service level to 80.5% for 09:00-15:30, meeting the 80% target at the lowest cost (₹5,892).","why":"General is short because of a sick wave, not because of extra calls. There are 9 sick absences against a usual 2.4, leaving 16 agents on the phones against 20 planned. Calls are actually 15% below forecast. With no action, service level over 09:00-15:30 is predicted at 68.0% (General 61.1%), with 7.4% abandons. P4 is predicted to reach 80.5% overall (Payments 84.7%, General 75.3%) and cut abandons to 4.2%. It does this by moving 20% of simple enquiries to chat on both queues, offering callbacks, delaying General breaks, and adding 6 overtime agents on General from 11:00 to 15:00. It is the cheapest plan that hits target with no policy violations. Rest of day is predicted at 86.7%.","trade_offs":["P3 (overtime on both queues) predicts 81.3%, with General at 77.3% and abandons at 3.8%. It is slightly stronger but costs ₹11,415, nearly double P4.","P2 (General overtime only) costs ₹7,815, more than P4, yet just misses target at 79.0%.","P1 (no-cost moves, ₹75) does not help: it predicts 66.9%, slightly worse than doing nothing (68.0%).","Under P4, General stays weakest at 75.3%. Results also depend on customers actually taking up chat and callbacks."],"watch":"Payments also has 7 sick absences against a usual 2.6, so the illness may be spreading. If more Payments or General agents drop out, or chat uptake is low, General could fall further below 80%. In that case, be ready to step up to P3's overtime on both queues and involve the duty manager."}
